items.title: Formula One’s Drive to Capture American Eyeballs Makes the Stock a Buy
items.summary: From Monte Carlo to Milan, the world of F1 has long been dripping with glamour, making stars out of drivers like Michael Schumacher and Lewis Hamilton, who are outshone only by the supercars themselves.  “From 1950 until about 2016, it was pretty badly run,” says Markus Hansen, a portfolio manager at Vontobel Asset Management, which owns  Liberty Media Series C Liberty Formula One  shares.  “In 2017, when Liberty Media took over Formula One, they brought a proper approach to running the business…to turning sports assets into viable financial businesses.”

items.title: Walt Disney Stock's Next Leg Depends On What It Has Been Building
items.summary: New park and cruise capacity is filling up while guests spend more per visit, and that pairing is the clearest upside case for Walt Disney stock.

items.title: Netflix Is Down, But One Billionaire Thinks the Stock Is a Buy
items.summary: Netflix has shed more than a third of its value over the past year, yet a billionaire who once lost $400 million betting on this exact stock just bought back in, and the reasoning behind his conviction is harder to dismiss than you might expect.
